staticText: WAEC/NECO result planner for Nigeria and Ghana. Nigeria output is a best-five planning index and credit audit, not an official admission aggregate. Ghana output uses English, Core Mathematics, the selected science or non-science programme core, and three entered electives. Never predict eligibility or invent cutoffs. Direct Nigeria users to JAMB IBASS and the institution portal; direct Ghana users to WAEC Ghana and the institution admissions page.
